stories.title: Anthropic shares fall below IPO price, a worrying sign for AI startups
stories.take: Anthropic slipped below its IPO price — the first big public-market wobble for a frontier lab, and a warning sign for every AI startup valuation behind it.

stories.title: 11 Things Jensen Huang Actually Said at His First All-Hands Back at Nvidia
stories.take: At his first all-hands back, Huang talked daily therapy, his 'tech bro' reputation, disdain for succession planning, and Trump — a remarkably unfiltered return tour.

stories.title: Amazon’s Decart acquisition is a bet on using software to narrow the silicon gap with Nvidia
stories.take: Amazon is paying a reported $7.5B for Decart to squeeze more efficiency out of its Trainium chips — software as the shortcut in the silicon race with Nvidia.

stories.title: Tidal announces ban on AI-generated music; 27 million tracks will be deleted
stories.take: Tidal will delete 27 million fully AI-generated tracks — 6.3% of its catalog goes to zero on Dec. 9, the boldest anti-slop move in streaming so far.

stories.title: Amazon drone crashes on garage after delivering shampoo, draws FAA probe
stories.take: A Prime Air drone clipped a cable and crashed into a garage after a shampoo drop; Amazon notes hundreds of thousands of deliveries this year, but the FAA is now probing.

stories.title: UK warns AI-driven cyberattacks are exposing years of weak security
stories.take: Britain's cyber agency says AI hacking tools mostly exploit basic, years-old security flaws — the fix is unglamorous fundamentals, done urgently.

stories.title: Kalshi makes “difficult decision” to halt Utah trading after losing court fights
stories.take: Kalshi paused Utah trading after losing in court — prediction markets' state-by-state legal grind is starting to bite.

stories.title: Advertising Is a Top Priority for Best Buy’s New CEO
stories.take: Best Buy's new CEO is putting advertising near the top of the agenda, with the retailer's ad business expected to grow 10% this year.

stories.title: Inflation, AI, and Tech Outages Will Reshape Holiday Shopping
stories.take: The NRF expects $1 trillion in holiday spend, but shoppers will budget harder, lean on AI, and punish retailers whose tech fails at checkout.

stories.title: Ad Tech Briefing: Meta eyes CTV as AppLovin circles Criteo, signs of the squeeze on independent ad tech
stories.take: Meta eyeing CTV and AppLovin circling Criteo point the same way: the platforms are closing in on what's left of independent ad tech.

stories.title: Chewy jumps on stop-motion animation trend lighting up holiday ads
stories.take: Chewy is the latest brand using stop-motion as a hand-made counterpoint to AI-generated holiday creative — craft as the differentiator.

stories.title: Agencies are selling AI efficiency — clients want outcomes
stories.take: Agencies pitched AI as a cost story for two years; clients say the savings never showed up on the invoice and now want results, not efficiency talk.

stories.title: It took designers 20 years to bring this font back from the dead
stories.take: Production Type spent 20 years reviving a Parisian classic typeface — a slow-craft story in an instant-generation era.

stories.title: Vocal Green swats back at online critics, fuels Warriors' victory over Celtics
stories.take: Draymond Green backed up a day of online bravado with a last-second defensive stop to close out an 88-87 Warriors win over Boston.

stories.title: Embiid misses game with illness as 76ers fall to Trail Blazers
stories.take: Joel Embiid sat out Monday with an illness and the 76ers fell to Portland — another reminder of how thin Philly's margin is without him.

stories.title: Golliver's too-early NBA All-Star picks: The 24 most deserving players right now
stories.take: Three months early, the All-Star locks and position battles are already taking shape across both conferences.

stories.title: NBA Rookie Rankings: Which stars are rising early in season?
stories.take: The first rookie rankings are out: 10 early standouts from a strong 2026 draft class are already separating themselves.

stories.title: Wolves' DiVincenzo cleared for basketball activities
stories.take: Minnesota gets a boost: Donte DiVincenzo is cleared for basketball activities after Achilles surgery.

stories.title: MLB rumors: Corey Seager willing to waive his NTC for Phillies, plus news on Mets, Nationals, Guardians, more
stories.take: The newest hot-stove rumor: Corey Seager would reportedly waive his no-trade clause for Philadelphia — a potential blockbuster lever for the Phillies.

stories.title: Freddy Peralta lands with Orioles: After post-trade turnaround, ALCS MVP scores five-year, $125 million deal
stories.take: Peralta's turnaround is complete: the ALCS MVP lands a five-year, $125M deal to top Baltimore's rotation after his disastrous Mets stint.

stories.title: Sources: Japanese right-hander Taira, Blue Jays agree to 5-year, $80M deal
stories.take: Toronto pivots fast after missing on Skubal: 5-foot-8 NPB right-hander Kaima Taira signs for five years and $80M, with an opt-out after year three.

stories.title: Sources: Cubs shore up rotation, agree to free agent deal with LHP Rogers
stories.take: Chicago's overhaul continues — Trevor Rogers joins Sato in the Cubs' spending spree, five years and $120M to rebuild the rotation.

stories.title: MLB drops escrow provision in salary cap proposal as talks take holiday hiatus
stories.take: With the Dec. 1 deadline nearing, MLB dropped its escrow demand from the cap proposal; overages would roll into future seasons instead. Talks pause for the holiday.

stories.title: Ortiz's wife urged Guardians pitcher to 'delete the evidence,' texts say
stories.take: Texts in the Luis Ortiz trial show his wife urging him to 'delete the evidence' after a game where he allegedly rigged a pitch — the gambling case keeps getting uglier.

stories.title: Democrat Victoria Broderick unseats eight-term Republican incumbent in Tennessee to win election
stories.take: Huge upset in Tennessee: Democrat Victoria Broderick flipped a district Trump carried by 20+ points, expanding the House majority to 259 — Democrats' largest in three decades.

stories.title: Trump honors Rudy Giuliani with presidential medal of freedom
stories.take: Trump awarded the Presidential Medal of Freedom to Rudy Giuliani, his former lawyer who was disbarred over efforts to overturn the 2020 election.

stories.title: Democrats demand records as investigation into Trump Jr’s investment firm widens
stories.take: The Trump Jr. probe widens: Democrats demanded records from four 1789 Capital-backed firms — GrabAGun, Hadrian, Juul and Polymarket — that won contracts or favorable rulings soon after.

stories.title: DEA allowed 1.4m fentanyl pills to be ‘walked’ into US during sting operation, report alleges
stories.take: An AP investigation alleges the DEA let 1.4 million fentanyl pills be trafficked into the US during a New Mexico sting — far more than the 74,000 previously reported.

stories.title: Storms and flooding in US could disrupt Thanksgiving travel for tens of millions
stories.take: Two storm systems — Pacific Northwest and East — bring heavy rain and strong winds into the holiday, threatening travel for tens of millions.

stories.title: Chinese neuroscientist at Princeton held by ICE after detention at D.C. airport
stories.take: A Princeton neuroscientist is being held by ICE after detention at D.C.'s airport; DHS says she overstayed her visa, her lawyer says she has a pending asylum application.

stories.title: High tide breaks 44-year-old record in San Francisco as communities brace for higher water
stories.take: King tides plus El Niño and a strong swell broke a 44-year-old San Francisco high-tide record — and forecasters say higher water is still coming this week.

stories.title: A man's severed head was found in a rural California town. His wife and daughter have been arrested
stories.take: Forensic genealogy cracked a years-old Placer County cold case: the victim is identified, and his wife and daughter are now under arrest.

stories.title: California city faces water contamination scare after alarm indicates a tank trespasser
stories.take: San Luis Obispo warned some residents after an alarm suggested a water-tank hatch was lifted and a substance may have entered the drinking water.

stories.title: CalPERS is changing the rules for retirees with part-time jobs. Here’s why
stories.take: CalPERS is clarifying its retired-annuitant rules with two new policies — the limits on working while drawing a pension trip up retirees and employers alike.

stories.title: Rise of anti-establishment Indian Americans like Nithya Raman signals a new political era
stories.take: LA mayor-elect Nithya Raman is part of a wave of anti-establishment Indian American winners succeeding on delivery, not heritage.

stories.title: Press freedom group calls for ICE to release Afghan journalist from California detention
stories.take: A press-freedom group wants ICE to release Afghan journalist Shaban Ali Rafat, held since January 2025 and facing deportation to Afghanistan.

stories.title: AI Just Made History in the Middle of a Meltdown
stories.take: Anthropic mathematician Levent Alpege, working with Claude, announced a proof of the Riemann hypothesis — a Millennium Prize problem open since 1859, published as 17 million lines of Lean code • The Lean community says it's correct, but human mathematicians object that no human can actually understand it, and bug claims are already circulating • Also: NYT reporting says Musk's xAI is falling behind and renting compute to rivals, and P vs NP becomes math's new 'final boss'

stories.title: Anthropic Shares Plunge 8% Below IPO Price in Fourth Trading Day
stories.take: Anthropic fell to $76.22, below its $83 IPO price on day four — a three-day losing streak after a 17% debut pop, on broad AI-trade pessimism and weak retail buy-in • SpaceX is also below its offer price; the IPO window looks closed through year-end and OpenAI has slipped to 2027 • Nvidia gave back 7% after its record 31% post-reinstatement rally

stories.title: Is Jensen Huang's reinstatement good news for China?
stories.take: The answer: mixed, not a clear win for China — Huang championed H200 chip sales to China, but Chinese state media suspects the saga's timing was US pressure, and the AI race stays fierce with Huawei advancing • Beijing denies spying on Huang; Asian markets welcomed his return • Also: Malaysia plans to repatriate up to 7,000 more Rohingya refugees to Myanmar

stories.title: Who wants to lead the Democrats?
stories.take: The answer: House — Hakeem Jeffries, unopposed, as Democrats' pick for Speaker; Senate — Chuck Schumer runs for majority leader, challenged by Maryland's Chris Van Hollen, with the vote next month • Hosts see little ideological split — it's mostly style, with the base wanting leaders who 'fight, fight, fight' • Their bottom line: the pick matters far less to voters than delivering on prices and stopping the Iran war

stories.title: NFL Kitchen Confidential: We Solved the Mystery of Andy Reid's Viral Mac-and-Cheese Recipe
stories.take: The answer: the seventh cheese is Velveeta — a few chunks for a smooth sauce — joining Fontina, Mozzarella, Parmesan, sharp cheddar, Gouda and Gruyère; the secret topping is corn flakes mixed with melted butter • An eight-year quest ended when ex-Chief Mitchell Schwartz got Reid to send the full recipe • Cooked with David Chang, it earned Reid's verdict: 'You're right on. Perfect.'

stories.title: Jensen Huang is Donald Trump’s Special Boy
stories.take: Trump personally reversed the board: Vance liaised over the weekend and Trump dialed into Sunday's board meeting, flipping a unanimous removal vote — the hosts call it naked corruption and presidential king-making • The underlying allegations were not resolved: new NYT reporting ties the woman at the center to China's spy agency • Friday's Anthropic-IPO market crash added pressure; stocks surged on Huang's return, then settled

stories.title: Why Trump saved Jensen Huang
stories.take: The answer: market optics — Nvidia is the market's biggest pillar and, with sentiment low and rates high, the stock market was what Trump had going for him; as the episode puts it, national security was trumped by economic optics • Trump also argued China might recruit Huang if the US didn't keep him • A 48-hour Trump-Vance lobbying push reversed the board, even as Trump's own DOJ runs three Nvidia-related probes
